title: 10 November 1968: George Harrison produces Is This What You Want? by Jackie Lomax
content:
The ninth Los Angeles recording session for Jackie Lomax’s debut album Is This What You Want? took place on this day at Sound Recorders Studio.

George Harrison produced the album for fellow Liverpudlian Lomax. It was released by Apple in March 1969.

During this day’s session musician Paul Beaver added synthesizer to the songs ‘I Fall Inside Your Eyes’, ‘Baby You’re A Lover’, and ‘How Can You Say Goodbye’. This was the penultimate LA session for the album.
